breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes both average normal stress and average shear stress in the maximum in-plane shear expression, τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), and does not repeat the incorrect instruction that maximum in-plane shear should be taken as average shear alone.
